description: hydrographr is an R package that wraps GDAL and GRASS GIS operations for large hydrographic raster and vector files. Its README names Hydrography90m and biodiversity layers, describes processing on disk in parallel, and links a method paper. Users provide river-network and spatial layers; outputs are derived catchment or stream attributes for selected areas. Geographic coverage follows the source layers, including global Hydrography90m where used. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing. A limitation is that the package depends on external GIS tools and source hydrography; river connectivity and resolution errors remain in derived outputs. It can prepare basin topology and environmental context for reservoir, water-quality or river-transport simulations. The related QGIS catalogue platform is a separate GIS environment. No Hydrography90m rasters or package were downloaded.
name: hydrographr hydrographic GIS processor
